subject: general
question:
Select the number from among the given alternatives that can replace the question mark (?) in the last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/25d318ff59eb237b2107ceb52ef039a9fa6a5cc99f0f65970d01906b901ddcb8.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37538f976eaaaa1cda168f6403b6033d5576f3343238c449f596061e01713437.png] ⇒ (3 + 6) × 7 = 9 × 7 → 63

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb88b8e2c72c232d581f1a8059649f745e957da87cf0a84578c546a33e31ce2f.png] ⇒ (13 + 12) × 3 = 25 × 3 → 75

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a121756f4d95bee9f6ee99f6a3442b44b936462aae31e582dc11e675147f5d65.png] ⇒ (4 + 18) × 2 = 22 × 2 → **44**

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
